name: print-social-maroon-cafe-menu-with-yellow-and-mint-cards-and-cutout-food
title: Maroon Cafe Menu with Yellow and Mint Cards
whatItIs: A square menu on deep maroon with a cream script-like brand title and a yellow serif MENU, and rounded cards in cream, yellow and mint for Breakfast, Protein, Brunch/Lunch, Pastries, Drinks and Extras, each with serif headings, item names with right-aligned prices and a cut-out food photo breaking out of the card corner, with a contact strip and stacked donuts.
whatItMeans: Colour-blocked cards make a long menu easy to scan, and photos poking out of the corners make it feel appetising.
techniques: Cut-out food photos overlapping card corners
Serif section headings over bold sans items
Maroon ground to make the pastel cards pop

vocabulary.definition: A rounded panel grouping one section of a menu.
An image that breaks out of its container's corner.
A right-aligned list of prices for scanning.
